review_evidence: README identifies the project as the `lake exe ast-export` command for exporting Lean parser ASTs to JSON.
All three Lean files were inspected/scanned; AstExport.lean implements JSON instances plus Lean parser/frontend traversal, while Main.lean/lakefile.lean provide executable/build plumbing.
